After the recent selloff tied to leadership headlines and financing concerns, this strong demand signal and the positive reaction in neocloud names (CoreWeave, Nebius, etc.) could mark a potential trend reversal on neoclouds names and a relief for investors still bullish on the AI infrastructure cycle. $NBIS $CRWV $IREN.
